item: The law ingest report counts revisions that barely moved and quotes the newest one's diff
refs: PR #2029; open-on-main row 72 (law part); field data 2026-11-08 and report 2026-11-14 §4.5
summary: Five legislation.gov.uk documents ended every poll in 'changed (+0 bytes)' or '(+1 bytes)': a new revision each time for a text whose size did not move, and their stored text keeps the skip link, the Cymraeg switch and 'Search Legislation' (the strip's stated limit). The cause cannot be read from field data that holds no revision text and cannot be fetched from the build sandbox (legislation.gov.uk still answers 000). The law-ingest report (field data) now gives each document its revision count, the count measured against the previous revision whose length moved by at most 16 characters (a first capture never counts), and the newest such revision's stored diff capped at 600 characters, so the next field report shows what changes. Counts and an excerpt, never a verdict or a filter on what the tracker records. The fix itself (read the five through their CLML data.xml, which carries no chrome) still waits on the one live fetch already parked for the operator.
